source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: There's a library near my house.
It's very quiet there and everyone reads.
I look for a book about history.
The woman by the door helps me.
I sit by the window and read.

sentences.ar: אחרי שעה אני לוקח את הספר הביתה.
sentences.en: After an hour I take the book home.
